key_insight: An anatomy-aware 3D GAN improved brain MRI inpainting over a simple 3D AutoEncoder but did not outperform the challenge’s Pix2Pix3D baseline.
clinical_relevance: The method synthesizes healthy-appearing tissue in masked brain tumor MRI regions for research, not drug discovery or validated clinical decision-making.
method: Combines mask-aware gated convolutions with mirrored contralateral brain context.
Uses attention-modulated skip fusion, boundary-aware refinement, and local masked-region refinement.
Trains with reconstruction objectives followed by low-weight adversarial fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: Official BraTS 2026 Task 4 evaluation across 219 cases yielded mean SSIM 0.658 and PSNR 14.81 dB, below local held-out results.
watch_item: Controlled ablations are still needed to isolate the contributions of mirrored context and the two-stage training schedule.
paper_title: Anatomy-Aware 3D GAN with Local Mask Refinement for Brain MRI Inpainting
